#define slurm_mutex_unlock(mutex)					\ /* <=== src/common/macros.h:212:221:slurm_mutex_unlock:1 */ 
	do {								\
		int err = pthread_mutex_unlock(mutex);			\
		if (err) {						\
			errno = err;					\
			fatal("%s:%d %s: pthread_mutex_unlock(): %m",	\
				__FILE__, __LINE__, __func__);		\
			abort();					\
		}							\
	} while (0)

#define safe_write(fd, buf, size) do {					\ /* <=== src/common/slurm_protocol_defs.h:1677:1699:safe_write:3 */ 
		int remaining = size;					\
		char *ptr = (char *) buf;				\
		int rc;							\
		while(remaining > 0) {					\
			rc = write(fd, ptr, remaining);			\
 			if (rc < 0) {					\
				if ((errno == EAGAIN) || (errno == EINTR))\
					continue;			\
				debug("%s:%d: %s: safe_write (%d of %d) failed: %m", \
				      __FILE__, __LINE__, __func__, \
				      remaining, (int)size);		\
				goto rwfail;				\
			} else {					\
				ptr += rc;				\
				remaining -= rc;			\
				if (remaining > 0)			\
					debug3("%s:%d: %s: safe_write (%d of %d) partial write", \
					       __FILE__, __LINE__, __func__, \
					       remaining, (int)size);	\
			}						\
		}							\
	} while (0)
